image_description: A collection of large plastic rain barrels arranged outdoors next to a white fence. The foreground features two reddish-brown barrels with visible horizontal ribbing, white straps or downspout attachments, and black circular lids/inlets on top. Behind them are several green barrels of similar design. A blue flexible hose connects to one of the background barrels. The setting appears to be a garden or storage area with brick paving.
